eps.o: Farmer Yumi and Farmer Al get stuck in the Haunted Maze; it's up to the Paw Patrol to rescue the farmers and solve this spooky mystery.

eps.t: Pups Save the Adventure Bay Boogie
eps.o: Sid Swashbuckle steals the Jack-O-Lantern Disco Ball at the Adventure Bay Boogie with C.
Skye, Everest, Liberty and Katie go on a camping adventure and encounter a polar bear with a sweet tooth.
When Julia and Julius put on a twin-credible magic show, they are convinced they accidentally turned Mr. Carter into a rabbit!

eps.t: Pups Save Hummy Mummy's New Home
eps.o: A pair of alligators take Mayor Humdinger's mother, Helga Humdinger, on a wild ride across Foggy Bottom!
Winnie Winnington is determined to beat Mayor Goodway and Chickaletta in a cooking competition to find Adventure Bay's best bakers.
Mr. Park has trouble with a Chickaletta topiary, but when Digi and Tal try to help, things get worse!
Humdinger creates havoc with a moose and geyser as he tours Yellowbone Park in his rolling Hum-Ball.
Farmer Al and Yumi are expecting a baby, when Al thinks his beloved goat Garbie is running away!
Farmer Yumi dreams about what her new baby will be like when she's bigger.

eps.t: Search & Rescue: Pups Save the Bike Race
eps.o: Adventure Bay is having a big bike race! With so many bikes on the road, it's going to be tough to keep everyone safe. Chase is on the case with his team of Search and Rescue Pups - a crew dedicated to keeping Adventure Bay as safe as possible!

eps.t: Search & Rescue: Pups Save a Snack Snatcher
eps.o: When the Adventure Bay potluck food goes missing, the Safety and Rescue pups deputize the whole community to track it down.

eps.t: Search & Rescue: Pups Save a Swept-Away Sweetheart
eps.o: Ms. Marjorie is paddleboarding out to celebrate her anniversary with Hurricane Harrigan on Seal Island when she mysteriously disappears!

eps.t: Search & Rescue: the Mystery of the Missing Kitties
eps.o: Mayor Humdinger can't find his kitties, so he runs to the Safety and Rescue Pups for help!

eps.t: Search and Rescue: Pups Help the Chickens Cross the Road
eps.o: Chickaletta's family is scattered around town, causing major traffic jams! The Safety and Rescue Pups have to help the chickens cross the road.

eps.t: Search and Rescue: Pups Save a Lost Ryder
eps.o: Chase leads a pup-tastic mission to rescue a lost Ryder which involves clues, tools, and - Chewington?!
Uncle Otis accidentally slips and tosses Julia and Julius' new goldfish, Marigold, into the river!
When Ms. Marjorie and Mr. Park don wingsuits to see a rare flower, a flying squirrel sends them off course!
When Rubble's cousin Mix comes to town to paint a mural, Humdinger steals the paint and careens through the countryside.
